library(shiny)

sfiles<-list.files(path="DDCV_function/",pattern=".R",full.names=TRUE)
for( fileA in sfiles) {source(fileA)}

shinyServer(function(input, output){
  
  inFile <- input$file1
  if (is.null(inFile))
    return(NULL)
  if (input$fty == "ShapeA") {
    mydata <- ShapeA(inFile$datapath,drug1=input$dname1,drug2=input$dname2,swap=input$swap)
  }
  if(input$fty == "ShapeB") {
    mydata <- ShapeB(inFile$datapath,drug1=input$dname1,drug2=input$dname2,swap=input$swap)
  }

  output$view <- renderTable({  
    IC50(drMatrix=mydata)
  })
  
  output$rmprofile <- renderPlot({
    rmProfile(drMatrix=mydata,drug1="TMZ",drug2="AZD7762")
  })
  
  output$meffect <- renderPlot({
    mEffect(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal1)
  })
  
  output$meffect2 <- renderPlot({
    mEffect2(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal2)
  })
  
  output$isob <- renderPlot({
    isobologram(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal3)
  })
  
  output$cindex <- renderPlot({
    cIndex(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal4) 
  })
  
  output$cshift <- renderPlot({
    cShift(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal5)
  })
  
  output$cshift2 <- renderPlot({
    cShift2(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal6)
  })
  
  output$usresponse <- renderPlot({
    usReponse(drMatrix=mydata,IC50base=input$normal7) 
  })
  
  output$dcontour <- renderPlot({
    dContour(drMatrix=mydata)
  })
})
